units.source_text: 当然，这盘棋按黑子着法，必然形成细棋。

en.t: Of course, given the way Black was playing, this game was bound to become a very close contest.

units.source_text: 大概是大竹七段想极力保住力量，哪怕是一目也好。

en.t: Otake Seventh Dan was probably trying his utmost to preserve his strength, even if only by a single point.

units.source_text: 但是，这也可以看成是白子的成功。

en.t: But this too could be regarded as a success for White.

units.source_text: 这倒不是名人施展了特别战术，也不是钻了黑子的败着，

en.t: It was not that the Master had used some special tactic, nor that he had taken advantage of a losing move by Black,

units.source_text: 而是顺着黑子稳健推进的着法，流水行云般轻轻松松地在下边围了大模样，

en.t: but rather that, following Black's steady course of play, he lightly and effortlessly built a large framework on the lower side, as naturally as flowing water and drifting clouds,

units.source_text: 不知不觉地变成了微妙的胜负局势，这也许是名人达到了成熟的境地。

en.t: and before anyone quite realized it, the position had turned into a delicate struggle for victory; perhaps this was the mature state the Master had reached.

units.source_text: 名人的棋力绝不因高龄减弱，也不因病痛受损。

en.t: The Master's playing strength had certainly not weakened with age, nor had it been impaired by illness.
